name: @red-cup-engineering/relation-model-notation-codecs-services-section
description: Holds the codec services for Relation Model Notation: bidirectional translations between some carrier shape and RMN terms. A named surface syntax, a wire format, a serialization convention -- each is a specific codec, not a separate notation. The grammar and the reducer live one level up; nothing that translates INTO or OUT OF a term belongs anywhere but here.
